entries.text: Fixed QuestDB transaction_primitives intermittently failing on transaction_rollback_small with a server NullPointerException (`Cannot invoke PGPipelineEntry.close() because pe is null`): psycopg auto-prepares a statement after five executions and issues DEALLOCATE ALL when a ROLLBACK completes, which QuestDB 10.0.1 cannot handle; the adapter now disables client-side auto-prepare on its connections.
